frontier.hypothesis: func_80065800 (active sibling in src/text1b.c, owner of jtbl_80015940 at src/text1a_b_pre_rodata.c:386-387, the cluster immediately before ours) reaching C would let both tables be emitted by text1b.o in ascending order, collapsing part of the pre/post rodata split and shrinking or eliminating the bb2.ld change this function needs.

frontier.next_probe: Apply steps 1-4 of the 2026-09-16 s11 entry in docs/grind/decisions.md and certify with verify-oracle --rebuild (SHA1), not the sandbox score, which stays at 2 by construction. A Judge scope-widening alone is insufficient: bb2.ld is outside the grantable scope classes.
